title: V2 drafted now but sequenced after V1
body: The operator asked to complete the roadmap tracking meta-plan by building out subplans. V2 is drafted now so the roadmap has a concrete guided-setup child, but it depends on V1 and should not lock until Capability Center + MCP read-only projection are accepted.

title: Setup runner starts print-only, then guarded execution
body: The safest sequencing is F001 print-only planning first, F002 guarded automatable execution second, F003 evidence close-out third. This prevents the setup runner from becoming a broad shell-execution surface before operators can inspect the generated plan.

title: F003 evidence record is operator-local by default; --evidence-dir redirects into plan evidence
body: `capabilities_setup_evidence.write_evidence()` defaults to `$DONTPANIC_HOME/setup-runs/<capability_id>-<ts>.json` (mode 0600, parent dir 0700) so an ad-hoc CLI run preserves a durable audit trail without polluting any plan's evidence/ directory. When the supervisor dispatches the runner inside a plan, it passes `--evidence-dir <plan>/evidence/` and the record lands beside the plan's other artifacts. Evidence persistence is unconditional for every governed `--automate-safe --confirm` run — the CLI exposes no bypass option. Secrets are kept out of the record by (a) reporting `requires` env entries as names only, never values; (b) preserving manifest `<PLACEHOLDER>` tokens verbatim in denied-step command templates so the operator sees what they would need to substitute; (c) capping stdout/stderr tails at 1000 chars and applying a layered regex sweep that redacts JWT, Authorization headers, prefix-style credential tokens (sk_*/ghp_*/xoxb-…/sk-ant-…), NAME=value env-prefix syntax, and generic token=/api_key=/password= forms to `[redacted-secret]` (preserving the key half where present). AMENDED 2026-05-22T23:55Z by claude: original draft of D003 claimed `--no-evidence` let an operator skip the write for exploratory invocations; that bypass was never implemented — `capabilities_setup.py` only exposes `--evidence-dir`, and `test_cli_has_no_no_evidence_bypass_for_governed_setup_runs` asserts the absence of any such flag. Wording above corrected to match shipped behavior (codex auditor F003-i0 finding, severity=low).
